tagline: Leading global renewable energy developer driving the clean energy transition through record capacity additions and strategic geographic expansion
hero_kpi_rationale: Primary growth driver in the renewables sector: each GW added directly increases the productive portfolio and future revenue streams. Record high of 3.8 GW in 2024 demonstrates execution capability despite an unfavorable environment marked by political uncertainties and permitting constraints.

kpis.name: Capacity Additions
kpis.explanation: New wind and solar capacity commissioned during the year.
kpis.description: In 2024, EDPR reached a record level of 3.8 GW of new capacity, bringing total managed capacity to 19.3 GW.
kpis.signal: Historical record in capacity additions in 2024

kpis.name: Managed Capacity
kpis.explanation: Total renewable energy capacity operated by EDPR worldwide.
kpis.description: Total managed capacity reached 19.3 GW at end-2024, a significant increase compared to the prior year, reflecting the impact of 3.8 GW of new capacity added.

kpis.name: Power Production
kpis.explanation: Total amount of electricity generated by EDPR's facilities.
kpis.description: Production reached 36.6 TWh in 2024, up 6% compared to 2023, despite below-average wind resources in Brazil and the United States.
kpis.signal: Solid growth despite weak wind conditions

kpis.name: Recurring EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before exceptional items such as gains from asset disposals.
kpis.description: Recurring EBITDA amounted to EUR 1.7 billion in 2024, down 9% due to lower gains from asset rotation, but with positive underlying performance and gross EBITDA up 9%.

kpis.name: Gross Investment
kpis.explanation: Total amount invested in new renewable projects.
kpis.description: EDPR invested EUR 4.1 billion in 2024 to develop its renewable project portfolio, supporting the commissioning of 3.8 GW of new capacity.
kpis.signal: Significant investment to support future growth

kpis.name: Recurring Net Profit
kpis.description: Recurring net profit amounted to EUR 0.2 billion (200 million euros) in 2024, demonstrating core profitability despite external challenges.

kpis.name: TSR
kpis.explanation: Total shareholder return, including capital appreciation and dividends.
kpis.description: EDPR's TSR declined by 45% in 2024, reflecting uncertainties in the United States and Europe as well as market pressures on pure-play renewable companies, including asset rotation execution challenges and offshore uncertainties.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline due to political and sectoral uncertainties

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of EUR 30.39 billion in the latest year

risks.title: Dependence on renewable energy support policies
risks.score_rationale: Major risk explicitly mentioned in Item 1A with high intensity. Policy changes in the US (Trump election, Executive Orders against offshore/onshore wind) and in Europe (weakening of net-zero ambitions by right-wing parties) directly threaten tax credits (ITC/PTC) and support mechanisms. Central to the group's growth strategy.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks affecting energy supply chains
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned with moderate-to-high intensity in Item 1A. Geopolitical tensions (Ukraine war, Middle East tensions) caused energy price volatility and supply chain disruptions in 2024. Direct impact on critical material costs and project timelines.

risks.title: Volatility in prices of critical raw materials
risks.score_rationale: Sector-specific risk. Item 1A details the enforcement of the Critical Raw Materials Act (May 2024) and supply challenges. Moderate language but strategic importance for turbine and solar panel manufacturing.

risks.title: Project permitting and execution risks for wind/solar projects
risks.score_rationale: Core business risk explicitly addressed. Item 1A mentions short-to-medium term execution challenges despite positive fundamentals. Record permitting in Europe (RED III) but US Executive Orders create uncertainty. Strategic position in group growth.

risks.title: Increased competition in the renewable energy sector
risks.score_rationale: Implicit but significant risk. Item 1A reports record renewable growth (666 GW in 2024, projected 935 GW in 2030) with Chinese dominance (80 GW wind, 277 GW solar). Moderate intensity but rising competitive pressure trend.

risks.title: Climate and weather risks on energy production
risks.score_rationale: Business-specific risk for renewables. Item 1A documents 2024 as the hottest year on record with extreme weather events (droughts, floods, cyclones). Direct impact on capacity factors and asset availability.

risks.title: Financing needs and leverage control
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned business risk at the start of Item 1A. The group is reducing 2025-2026 capacity additions and controlling financial leverage while maintaining CAPEX investments (EUR 3.4 billion). Direct language on financing constraints.

risks.title: Dependence on availability and cost of skilled labor
risks.score_rationale: Implicit but relevant risk. Item 1A notes that field teams are engaged in project development and management. The Net Zero Industry Act (July 2024) highlights the need for skilled workforce development, creating cost pressures.

ai_positioning.summary: EDPR explicitly recognizes the impact of artificial intelligence on global electricity demand. The 2024 report identifies the rapid expansion of AI and data centers as a key driver of unprecedented growth in electricity consumption, creating a major structural opportunity for the renewables sector.
evidence: MD&A Statement: 'Global electricity consumption is also set to rise at an unprecedented pace, driven by the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) and data centres'
Convergence with IEA forecast: 'the International Energy Agency (IEA) predicts record-breaking growth in renewables worldwide, calling this the dawn of the electricity era'
EDPR positioning: its renewable capacity (19.3 GW) and investment (EUR 4.1 billion) position the company to capture this growing demand driven by AI
